name: io.github.cameron-creations/numberbroom-mcp
description: Verify US phone numbers: line type, carrier, and TCPA litigator status via the NumberBroom API. Sign in with OAuth or use an API key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: your NumberBroom API key as a Bearer token: "Bearer nb_live_...". Clients that sign in with OAuth do not need it. Get one at https://numberbroom.com/settings.
